html:
Living with severe arthritis can make even the simplest tasks feel like an uphill battle. When joint pain begins to restrict your independence, deciding to undergo a knee replacement in Ahmedabad is a major milestone toward reclaiming your quality of life. But as you research your options, you will quickly notice that the world of orthopaedics has evolved.

Robotic surgery is now the gold standard, but not all robotic systems are created equal. At Silver Touch Hospitals, we utilise state-of-the-art, CT-free robotic technology. Here is why this advanced, imageless approach offers a much safer, more precise experience than traditional robotic methods.

The Big Win: Zero Pre-Operative Radiation

Traditional robotic knee surgeries rely heavily on a pre-operative CT scan. Before you even step into the operating theatre, you are required to undergo a specialized scan to build a 3D model of your joint.

  • The CT-Free Difference: With our modern imageless system, we completely bypass this step. You are not exposed to unnecessary, high-dose radiation from CT scans.
  • Fewer Hospital Visits: You don’t have to schedule extra diagnostic appointments or wait days for the engineering team to process your scans. Everything is done dynamically on the day of your procedure.

Static Pictures vs. Real-Time Dynamic Mapping

Traditional robots operate like a GPS using an old map—they rely purely on the static images taken days prior. However, your knee joint is dynamic, involving complex ligaments, muscles, and soft tissues that change tension when move.

Our advanced CT-free system uses infrared cameras and optical trackers during the surgery to map your joint live.

  • Perfect Alignment: The system calculates your exact leg alignment down to a fraction of a millimetre.
  • Soft Tissue Balance: It measures how your ligaments stretch in real-time, ensuring the knee feels completely natural when you walk.
  • Customised Cuts: Your surgeon can precisely plan and execute bone cuts that perfectly match your natural anatomy.

Why Soft Tissue Balance Matters?

A perfectly aligned metal implant can still feel stiff if the surrounding ligaments are too tight. Live tracking allows us to adjust the fit dynamically, leading to a much smoother, more comfortable recovery.

By eliminating the rigid constraints of older systems, we drastically reduce the risk of human error and ensure less damage to the surrounding healthy tissues.

When it comes to your mobility, choosing the right technology for your knee replacement in Ahmedabad comes down to safety, precision, and a faster return to daily life. At Silver Touch Hospitals, our multi-specialty team is dedicated to providing world-class orthopaedic care that puts your long-term comfort first.
